title: Yuz o'girgan hamroh
intro: Siz payg'ambarlik soyasida yashagan, ammo halokatga olib boradigan yo'lni tanlagan ruhning hikoyasini ochib bermoqchisiz. Bu shaxs Allohning tanlangan elchilaridan biri bilan uyda yashagan, ammo imon sinovidan o'ta olmagan. Bu adashgan hamroh kim?
clues: Men adolatga chaqiruvni rad etgan odamlar orasida yashadim va ularga qarshilik ko'rsatmadim.
Men Allohning payg'ambariga uylangan edim, lekin bu e'tiqodga qo'shilmadim.
Xabarchilar uyimga ogohlantirish bilan kelishganida, men ularga ishonmadim.
Turmush o'rtog'imga shaharni mo'minlar bilan tark etish buyurilgan edi va men ular orasida yo'q edim.
Azob xalqimga tushdi va men ular bilan birga yo'q qilindim.
Men Qur'onda Nuhning xotini bilan birga "Tahrim" surasida kufrga misol sifatida tilga olinganman.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
